Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32190-01.html.text: Vice Hierarch Mao: Welcome! I have heard about you from the elder. In your case, there is no need to traverse this dungeon from the beginning. It is not as though you are being tested! Here -- Mother Nornil is waiting for you...
